events.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup Winner
events.description:
This market will resolve according to the national team that wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

If at any point it becomes impossible for this team to win the FIFA World Cup based on the rules of FIFA (e.g., they are eliminated in the knockout stage), this market will resolve immediately to “No”.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is permanently canceled or has not been completed by October 13, 2026, 11:59 PM this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from FIFA, however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Spain edges France as the slim trader consensus favorite for the 2026 FIFA World Cup winner, reflecting La Roja's sustained momentum from their Euro 2024 triumph and strong UEFA qualifying campaign, though recent March friendlies saw Les Bleus stun Spain 1-0 via Saliba's header and edge Brazil 2-1 with Mbappé's opener. France's ascent to the top FIFA ranking after Spain's minor slip underscores their individual talent depth and defensive solidity. The tight top cluster—Spain at 17.2%, France 16.2%, England 11.1%—highlights fierce European rivalry alongside South American heavyweights like Argentina (topped CONMEBOL standings) and Brazil, amplified by the expanded 48-team format's longer group stages and potential knockout upsets in a wide-open field with all squads now confirmed post-March playoffs.
